newsitem.title: FRANCE: MEPs urges EU to raise profile in Transcaucasus.
newsitem.headline: MEPs urges EU to raise profile in Transcaucasus.

text.p: The European Parliament urged the European Union on Friday to increase its presence in Armenia, Azerbaijan and Georgia.
The call responded to a European Commission communication, COM(95)205, on a new EU strategy on relations with the three transcaucasian republics.

Euro-MPs pointed out that the transcaucasian states were participants in NATO's Partnership for Peace programme and therefore had a useful contribution to make in discussions on NATO's expansion eastwards.
They said the EU could increase its influence in the region by opening embassies there, helping consolidate the independence of the three states, and promoting economic, political and social reform.
